    The radical of an indecomposable endomorphism ring #

    The anti-exchange argument uses the Jacobson radical of the local endomorphism ring of an indecomposable finite-length module. Mathlib proves that the Jacobson radical of an Artinian ring is nilpotent. This file identifies its elements with the noninvertible endomorphisms and packages the iteration-on-images argument needed by the manuscript.

    Nonempty (X ≃ₗ[A] Y)

    If a composite X → Y → X is invertible and both modules are indecomposable, then the first map is a linear equivalence onto Y.
